{{Top|leg}}
'''The Explorer's Guild''' was a private room established at [[Exovar's Emporium]] dedicated to [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], adventurers, and explorers. It was the largest room at Exovar's dedicated to a single profession, and contained audio-visual holographies of some of the pioneers of the scouting field.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
